final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-17) gives this number. A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-17 found the same setting: branch main is protected, needs 2 approving reviews and applies to administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository, not any other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:4fc929fc-7ce1-4dbf-8cac-ff012caa7: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:0572d888-e459-4351-bb8c-6adfaa9d4: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:28bf9320-dd14-49ef-a6fb-9dcddf3c6: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:68818ebf-ceb8-42e6-8b66-295971108: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:05b293a2-19d0-4e35-aeaf-f26b1a3ac: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
evidence:a59502a8-c83b-4e6e-b3de-e37449d: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-17 01:04 UTC.
